prior_year_events.event_name: Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) and Quota Share (QS)
prior_year_events.impact_description: reinsuring the loss reserves on the 2022 and prior years of account to MPMIC. This will provide stability to the syndicate on any future loss movements.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross claims reserve release of GBP 19.063 million in 2022, representing 23.85% of its opening gross reserves. This movement is primarily attributed to a Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) and Quota Share (QS) transaction with its Parent Company, MPMIC, which reinsured the loss reserves for the 2022 and prior years of account. This transaction aims to provide stability to the syndicate on future loss movements.
raw_causal_phrases: An LPT and QS has been put into place reinsuring the loss reserves on the 2022 and prior years of account to MPMIC.
This will provide stability to the syndicate on any future loss movements.
data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure is derived from the 'Movement in technical account' for gross claims provision, which is heavily influenced by a Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) and Quota Share (QS) transaction covering 2022 and prior years' reserves. This makes it difficult to isolate organic prior year development.
